summary_en: This first-in-human Phase 1 study tests UBX-303061 in adults with relapsed or refractory B-cell malignancies. The drug is given by mouth (oral), and how long or how often it is given is not stated. The study evaluates safety and anti-cancer activity.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1, en humanos por primera vez, evalúa UBX-303061 en adultos con neoplasias de células B recidivantes o refractarias. El medicamento se administra por vía oral, y no se indica cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia. El estudio evalúa la seguridad y la actividad anticáncer.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who can give signed informed consent.
Relapsed or refractory B-cell malignancy after at least 2 prior therapies, or no available treatment options per the investigator.
Measurable or evaluable disease based on tumor type criteria.
Adequate organ and bone marrow function.
not_for: Previously treated with BTK degradation therapy.
CAR-T therapy within 100 days before study drug start.
Allogeneic stem cell transplant within 6 months, or active graft-versus-host disease.
Known hypersensitivity to BTK degraders or their ingredients.
Impaired cardiac function, clinically significant cardiac disease, or severe bleeding disorders.
